text:
Lost gift card codes can be reissued. The purchaser just needs to give us the **gift card order number** (the order where the card was bought), and we'll send a replacement code. The policy doesn't state how long reissuing takes, so I can't promise a timeframe.

Gift cards can't be cashed out. They're not refundable for cash, but they never expire, so the balance will be there when you have the code again.

If you're not the purchaser, the purchaser will need to be the one to provide the order number.
